task.title: Materialize policy-learning service boundary without production activation
task.summary_zh: 建立 policy-learning-svc 的 service boundary 與非 production stub HTTP surface，用來承接未來 policy learning job lifecycle；不得啟用 Qlib/TRL/RL production activation。
acceptance: policy-learning service exposes health capability list job proposal status and rejection APIs
Dockerfile env storage and compose wiring are added
Qlib TRL RL and W&B production activation remain out of scope and disabled by default
tests prove disabled production adapters are rejected and stub lifecycle is replayable
task.next: Owner finalized approved task and closed it. Policy-learning service boundary is committed without production activation; focused tests, py_compile, and docker compose config passed.
review_notes_zh: policy-learning service boundary 通過 review：FastAPI surface 覆蓋 health/capabilities/jobs/proposal/status/reject，JSON store 可 replay；compose 以 8100、named volume、/health healthcheck 與 POLICY_LEARNING_ENABLE_PRODUCTION_ADAPTERS=false 接線；Qlib/TRL/RL/W&B production adapter request 預設 rejected，未啟用 production learning runtime；驗證 pytest/py_compile/docker compose config 全數通過。
